verdict.rationale: Proa documents its own performance and maintainability tooling. This includes compile-time template validation and static-markup consolidation, lints that flag avoidable allocations and intermediate strings, and render-preserving format checks. It also ships typed components and request context, build-time accessibility checks, cross-view field flagging, tiny island runtimes, streaming Suspense, page caching, and reproducible benchmarks. None of this shows how apps actually hold up at large team or codebase scale. Missing for 10: evidence of large-codebase or multi-team scaling (modularization, build-time behavior at scale, case studies), independent or hands-on corroboration of performance and maintainability at size.
